messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **long‑weekend holidays that apply nationwide in Canada for 2023**.  
(If a statutory holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, the adjacent weekend days create a three‑day break. If it falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the day off is observed on the following Monday, giving a four‑day stretch.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** (Sunday‑Monday‑Tuesday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 20 – May 22** (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jun 30 – Jul 3** (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Friday | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | **Dec 25 – Dec 27** (Monday‑Tuesday‑Wednesday) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional statutory holidays (e.g., Family Day on Feb 20 in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan, and New Brunswick; St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that also create long weekends.  
> • The table above lists only the holidays that are **nationwide statutory holidays** and therefore apply to all Canadians.  

Feel free to integrate this list into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can provide those as well.
